factor_value.evidence: Serum samples were routinely collected from patients with metastatic melanoma with low tumor load treated within a phase I/II trial (ClinicalTrials.gov Identifier: NCT01614301) after giving written informed consent.

number_of_biological_replicates.evidence: In three patients, two of which suffered from cachexia, a tissue damage signature was determined, consisting of nine proteins
